Getting pressure layers for vessel traffic.

Yearly GeoTIFF outputs (uncapped + capped) for each pressure are built in the chunks below. Set OHI_SKIP_TRAFFIC_GHOST=1 to rebuild the bottom-trawl rasters without rewriting vessel traffic or ghost gear.

Some raster functions

VMS_ROOT <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/vms_juan_carlos"
CAP_YEAR <- 2024L
YEAR_MIN <- 2007L
YEAR_MAX <- 2025L
HOURS_CAP <- 3

load_vms_year <- function(year) {
  vms_path <- file.path(VMS_ROOT, "vms", sprintf("vms_%s.csv", year))
  if (!file.exists(vms_path)) stop("Missing VMS file: ", vms_path)

  read_csv(vms_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-name, -port, -economic_unit) %>%
    left_join(vessels, by = "vessel_rnpa")  # uses GoC-filtered registry from chunk above
}

filter_vessel_traffic <- function(vms_year) {
  vms_year %>%
    filter(!is.na(hours), hours > 0) %>%
    mutate(hours = pmin(hours, HOURS_CAP)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon))
}

rasterize_to_marine <- function(pings, field, layer_name) {
  pings_sf <- pings %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
    st_transform(crs(ohi_marine))

  out <- rasterize(
    vect(pings_sf),
    y = ohi_marine,
    field = field,
    fun = "sum",
    background = 0
  )
  out <- ifel(is.na(ohi_marine), NA, out)
  names(out) <- layer_name
  out
}

write_pressure_pair <- function(r, uncapped_path, capped_path, cap_value) {
  dir.create(dirname(uncapped_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  writeRaster(r, uncapped_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(ifel(r > cap_value, cap_value, r), capped_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}

Used for noise and strike risk. Only includes fishing vessels. Ideally this should be supplemented with other data that includes tour ships, etc.

Build yearly vessel-traffic GeoTIFFs (Pressure 1 only).

Sum of VMS hours per 1 km cell; hours capped at 3 h per ping.

Capped rasters use the 2024 99th-percentile value (fixed across years).

## Cap from 2024
message("Computing 99th-percentile cap from ", CAP_YEAR, " (vessel traffic)")
pings_cap <- load_vms_year(CAP_YEAR) %>% filter_vessel_traffic()
r_cap <- rasterize_to_marine(pings_cap, "hours", "hours_count")
q99_vessel <- as.numeric(quantile(values(r_cap), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Vessel traffic 99th-percentile cap: ", signif(q99_vessel, 4))

## All years
years <- YEAR_MIN:YEAR_MAX
walk(years, function(year) {
  message("\n=== Vessel traffic year ", year, " ===")
  pings <- load_vms_year(year) %>% filter_vessel_traffic()
  r <- rasterize_to_marine(pings, "hours", "hours_count")
  uncapped <- file.path(PRESSURE_ROOT, "vessel_traffic", sprintf("vms_hours_%s_1km.tif", year))
  capped <- file.path(PRESSURE_ROOT, "vessel_traffic", sprintf("vms_hours_%s_1km_capped.tif", year))
  write_pressure_pair(r, uncapped, capped, q99_vessel)
  message("Wrote ", basename(uncapped), " and ", basename(capped))
})

message("\nDone. Wrote ", length(years), " years of vessel traffic rasters (uncapped + capped).")

Sum of VMS hours per 1 km cell, aligned to ohi_marine_raster_1km.tif (EPSG:6372). Written by the chunk above (also available via scripts/build_vessel_pressure_rasters.R).

hours_count <- rast(file.path(
  PRESSURE_ROOT,
  "vessel_traffic",
  "vms_hours_2024_1km_capped.tif"
))

colors <- paletteer_c("ggthemes::Classic Orange-Blue", 100)[1:55]
plot(log1p(hours_count), main = "VMS hours per 1 km cell (2024, capped)", col = rev(colors))

Pressure 2: demersal destructive fishing pressure

Gear type × target species combinations

All unique pairs in the GoC vessel registry (six states), with vessel counts. bottom_destructive flags combinations likely to include bottom trawling with benthic impact (permit-level inference). Rules:

  • Sardine/anchovy never bottom trawl, even if the gear is arrastre.
  • Tuna without shrimp never bottom trawl, even if the gear is arrastre and escama is also listed. That permit can be a midwater trawl.
  • Shrimp is bottom trawl, including when the gear is OTRO, missing, PESCA MULTIPLE, longline, purse seine, or pole-and-line. Those boats match the industrial shrimp-trawl fleet.
  • NA + NA is unclassified (bottom_destructive = NA → excluded from bottom-trawl layers).
gear_target_combos <- vessels %>%
  count(gear_type, target_species, name = "n_vessels", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    gear_chr = coalesce(gear_type, ""),
    target_chr = coalesce(target_species, ""),
    has_trawl = str_detect(gear_chr, "ARRASTRE"),
    has_purse_seine = str_detect(gear_chr, "CERCO"),
    has_longline = str_detect(gear_chr, "PALANGRE"),
    has_pesca_multiple = gear_chr == "PESCA MULTIPLE",
    has_shrimp_target = str_detect(target_chr, "CAMARÓN"),
    has_finfish_target = str_detect(target_chr, "ESCAMA"),
    has_sardine_target = str_detect(target_chr, "SARDINA"),
    has_tuna_target = str_detect(target_chr, "ATÚN"),
    has_shark_target = str_detect(target_chr, "TIBURÓN"),
    has_tuna_only = has_tuna_target & !has_shrimp_target & !has_finfish_target &
      !has_shark_target & !has_sardine_target,
    has_otras_target = str_detect(target_chr, "OTRAS"),
    gear_missing = is.na(gear_type) | gear_chr == "",
    target_missing = is.na(target_species) | target_chr == "",
    ambiguous_gear = gear_missing | gear_chr == "OTRO" | has_pesca_multiple,
    bottom_destructive = case_when(
      gear_missing & target_missing ~ NA,
      ## Sardine/anchovy: never bottom trawl (even if ARRASTRE on permit)
      has_sardine_target ~ FALSE,
      ## Tuna without shrimp: never bottom trawl, even if arrastre also lists escama
      has_tuna_target & !has_shrimp_target ~ FALSE,
      ## Shrimp + ambiguous gear (OTRO, NA gear, PESCA MULTIPLE): treat as bottom trawl
      has_shrimp_target & ambiguous_gear ~ TRUE,
      ## Trawl on permit (non-sardine, non-tuna targets)
      has_trawl ~ TRUE,
      ## Shrimp on longline, purse seine, or pole-and-line: same industrial trawl fleet
      has_shrimp_target ~ TRUE,
      ## Pelagic / hook gear without trawl
      !has_trawl & (has_purse_seine | has_longline) ~ FALSE,
      ## Unspecified buckets without shrimp
      !has_trawl & (gear_chr == "OTRO" | has_otras_target) ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    confidence = case_when(
      gear_missing & target_missing ~ NA_character_,
      has_sardine_target ~ "high",
      has_tuna_only ~ "high",
      has_shrimp_target & ambiguous_gear ~ "low",
      has_trawl & has_shrimp_target & !has_longline & !has_pesca_multiple ~ "high",
      has_trawl & has_shrimp_target ~ "medium",
      has_trawl & has_finfish_target & !has_shrimp_target ~ "medium",
      has_trawl ~ "medium",
      has_shrimp_target ~ "high",
      !has_trawl & (has_purse_seine | has_longline) ~ "high",
      !has_trawl & gear_chr == "OTRO" & has_otras_target ~ "high",
      !has_trawl & (has_tuna_target) & !has_shrimp_target ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ "high"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-gear_chr, -target_chr, -has_trawl, -has_purse_seine, -has_longline,
         -has_pesca_multiple, -has_shrimp_target, -has_finfish_target,
         -has_sardine_target, -has_tuna_target, -has_shark_target, -has_tuna_only,
         -has_otras_target,
         -gear_missing, -target_missing, -ambiguous_gear) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_vessels), gear_type, target_species)

dir.create(here("_pressures/vessels/data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(
  gear_target_combos,
  here("_pressures/vessels/data/gear_target_benthic_destructive.csv")
)

Get 99th-percentile cap value (from 2024)

Filter pings for potential bottom-destructive trawling

Keep VMS pings that plausibly reflect bottom trawling, using permit metadata (gear_target_combos) and speed. Depth is not a cutoff. Each step below drops pings that fail that step; the table shows how many rows remain.

Permit rule: we only require a bottom_destructive assessment on the permit (gear × target combo). Pings are dropped when bottom_destructive is NA (unclassified combo, mainly missing gear and target). We do not drop pings solely because gear_type or target_species is missing if the combo still has bottom_destructive TRUE or FALSE (e.g. shrimp with inferred bottom trawl when gear is OTRO or missing).

Also applied: each ping’s hours is capped at 3 h before summing (limits inflation from long gaps between VMS reports).

## Shared by bottom-trawl and ghost-pressure filter chunks.
filter_step <- function(label, n_in, n_out) {
  message(
    sprintf(
      "%s: %s → %s pings (removed %s)",
      label,
      format(n_in, big.mark = ","),
      format(n_out, big.mark = ","),
      format(n_in - n_out, big.mark = ",")
    )
  )
}
## Lookup: one row per gear + target combination (from registry, not from VMS pings).
destructive_lookup <- gear_target_combos %>%
  select(gear_type, target_species, bottom_destructive)

## Attach permit-based bottom-trawl flag to every ping.
pings_with_permit <- vessel_pressure %>%
  left_join(destructive_lookup, by = c("gear_type", "target_species"))

n_start <- nrow(pings_with_permit)

## 1) Drop pings with no bottom_destructive assessment (NA on permit combo).
pings_assessed <- pings_with_permit %>%
  filter(!is.na(bottom_destructive))
filter_step("1. bottom_destructive assessed (not NA)", n_start, nrow(pings_assessed))
## 1. bottom_destructive assessed (not NA): 1,248,398 → 1,187,436 pings (removed 60,962)
## 2) Keep only permit combinations classified as bottom-destructive (see gear_target_combos chunk).
pings_destructive <- pings_assessed %>%
  filter(bottom_destructive == TRUE)
filter_step("2. Bottom-destructive permit combo", nrow(pings_assessed), nrow(pings_destructive))
## 2. Bottom-destructive permit combo: 1,187,436 → 730,707 pings (removed 456,729)
## 3) Drop fast transit legs (speed between consecutive pings, in knots).
## No depth cutoff: pings deeper than 100 m stay in the layer.
pings_trawling_speed <- pings_destructive %>%
  filter(!is.na(implied_speed_knots), implied_speed_knots <= 6)
filter_step("3. Implied speed ≤ 6 knots", nrow(pings_destructive), nrow(pings_trawling_speed))
## 3. Implied speed ≤ 6 knots: 730,707 → 650,167 pings (removed 80,540)
## 4) Valid positions and positive time step (for later sum(hours) rasters).
pings_valid <- pings_trawling_speed %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(hours), hours > 0)

filter_step("4. Valid lat/lon and hours > 0", nrow(pings_trawling_speed), nrow(pings_valid))
## 4. Valid lat/lon and hours > 0: 650,167 → 650,167 pings (removed 0)
## 5) Cap hours at 3 h so one long gap between pings cannot add >3 vessel-hours to a cell.
n_capped <- sum(pings_valid$hours > 3, na.rm = TRUE)

vessel_pressure_bottom <- pings_valid %>%
  mutate(hours = pmin(hours, 3))

message(
  sprintf(
    "5. Cap hours at 3 h: %s pings had hours > 3 before cap (all %s rows kept)",
    format(n_capped, big.mark = ","),
    format(nrow(vessel_pressure_bottom), big.mark = ",")
  )
)
## 5. Cap hours at 3 h: 534 pings had hours > 3 before cap (all 650,167 rows kept)
## Summary table
tibble(
  step = c(
    "All pings (with bottom_destructive joined)",
    "After: bottom_destructive assessed (not NA)",
    "After: bottom-destructive permit (TRUE)",
    "After: speed ≤ 6 kn",
    "After: valid position and hours > 0",
    "Final: hours capped at 3 h per ping"
  ),
  n_pings = c(
    n_start,
    nrow(pings_assessed),
    nrow(pings_destructive),
    nrow(pings_trawling_speed),
    nrow(pings_valid),
    nrow(vessel_pressure_bottom)
  ),
  pct_of_start = round(100 * c(
    n_start,
    nrow(pings_assessed),
    nrow(pings_destructive),
    nrow(pings_trawling_speed),
    nrow(pings_valid),
    nrow(vessel_pressure_bottom)
  ) / n_start, 1)
)

Build yearly bottom-destructive GeoTIFFs (Pressure 2 only).

Same filters as above: permit TRUE, implied speed ≤ 6 kn, hours capped at 3 h.

No depth cutoff. Capped rasters use the 2024 99th-percentile value.

destructive_lookup <- gear_target_combos %>%
  select(gear_type, target_species, bottom_destructive)

filter_bottom_destructive <- function(vms_year) {
  vms_year %>%
    left_join(destructive_lookup, by = c("gear_type", "target_species")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bottom_destructive), bottom_destructive == TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(implied_speed_knots), implied_speed_knots <= 6) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(hours), hours > 0) %>%
    mutate(hours = pmin(hours, HOURS_CAP))
}

message("Computing 99th-percentile cap from ", CAP_YEAR, " (bottom-destructive fishing)")
## Computing 99th-percentile cap from 2024 (bottom-destructive fishing)
pings_cap <- load_vms_year(CAP_YEAR) %>% filter_bottom_destructive()
r_cap <- rasterize_to_marine(pings_cap, "hours", "bottom_trawl_hours")
q99_bottom <- as.numeric(quantile(values(r_cap), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Bottom-destructive 99th-percentile cap: ", signif(q99_bottom, 4))
## Bottom-destructive 99th-percentile cap: 48
years <- YEAR_MIN:YEAR_MAX
walk(years, function(year) {
  message("\n=== Bottom-destructive year ", year, " ===")
  pings <- load_vms_year(year) %>% filter_bottom_destructive()
  r <- rasterize_to_marine(pings, "hours", "bottom_trawl_hours")
  uncapped <- file.path(
    PRESSURE_ROOT,
    "benthic_destructive_fishing",
    sprintf("destructive_fishing_hours_%s_1km.tif", year)
  )
  capped <- file.path(
    PRESSURE_ROOT,
    "benthic_destructive_fishing",
    sprintf("destructive_fishing_hours_%s_1km_capped.tif", year)
  )
  write_pressure_pair(r, uncapped, capped, q99_bottom)
  message("Wrote ", basename(uncapped), " and ", basename(capped))
})

Pressure 3: Ghost gear risk

Attach Gilman et al. (2021) scores to every VMS ping via the vessel permit (gear_type + target_species). Crosswalk: data/gear_gilman_crosswalk.csv (built from data/gear_target_benthic_destructive.csv via build_gilman_crosswalk.Rmd).

Per-ping score: ghost_gear_risk = H_gear_ghost = R × ghost_fishing_mean (Table 2 ALDFG leakage rate R × Supplement Table S2 ghost-fishing mean). This is not H_gear × ghost_fishing_mean (that would multiply in Table 2 outcome O as well). H_gear = R × O is the general gear hazard index; we use the ghost-specific index only.

Pings whose permit has both gear and target missing stay NA (unclassified combo in the crosswalk).

gilman_by_permit <- read_csv(
  here("_pressures/vessels/data/gear_gilman_crosswalk.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  select(
    gear_type,
    target_species,
    gilman_gear = gilman_gear_category,
    gilman_R = R,
    ghost_fishing_mean,
    H_gear_ghost)

Get 99th quantile from 2024

Filter pings for ghost gear pressure

Keep VMS pings that plausibly reflect fishing activity (not fast transit), with a Gilman ghost score on the permit. Each step drops pings that fail that step.

Permit rule: drop pings only when ghost_gear_risk is NA (no Gilman assessment for that gear × target combo, mainly missing gear and target). Pings with missing gear_type or target_species are kept if the crosswalk still assigns a score (e.g. shrimp target with inferred bottom trawl).

Also applied: hours capped at 3 h; per-ping contribution = ghost_gear_risk × hours_capped (risk-weighted vessel-hours).

n_start <- nrow(ghost_pressure)

## 1) Drop pings without a Gilman ghost score (NA = no assessment for permit combo).
ghost_scored <- ghost_pressure %>%
  filter(!is.na(ghost_gear_risk))
filter_step("1. ghost_gear_risk assessed (not NA)", nrow(ghost_pressure), nrow(ghost_scored))
## 1. ghost_gear_risk assessed (not NA): 1,248,398 → 1,187,436 pings (removed 60,962)
## 2) Drop fast transit legs (speed between consecutive pings, in knots).
ghost_fishing_speed <- ghost_scored %>%
  filter(!is.na(implied_speed_knots), implied_speed_knots <= 6)
filter_step("2. Implied speed ≤ 6 knots", nrow(ghost_scored), nrow(ghost_fishing_speed))
## 2. Implied speed ≤ 6 knots: 1,187,436 → 983,556 pings (removed 203,880)
## 3) Valid positions and positive time step (for raster sum).
ghost_valid <- ghost_fishing_speed %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(hours), hours > 0)
filter_step("3. Valid lat/lon and hours > 0", nrow(ghost_fishing_speed), nrow(ghost_valid))
## 3. Valid lat/lon and hours > 0: 983,556 → 983,556 pings (removed 0)
## 4) Cap hours at 3 h and multiply by permit-level ghost gear risk.
n_capped <- sum(ghost_valid$hours > 3, na.rm = TRUE)
ghost_pressure <- ghost_valid %>%
  mutate(
    hours_capped = pmin(hours, 3),
    ghost_risk_hours = ghost_gear_risk * hours_capped
  )

message(
  sprintf(
    "4. Cap hours at 3 h: %s pings had hours > 3 before cap (all %s rows kept)",
    format(n_capped, big.mark = ","),
    format(nrow(ghost_pressure), big.mark = ",")
  )
)
## 4. Cap hours at 3 h: 2,656 pings had hours > 3 before cap (all 983,556 rows kept)
## Summary table
tibble(
  step = c(
    "All pings (with Gilman scores joined)",
    "After: ghost_gear_risk assessed (not NA)",
    "After: speed ≤ 6 kn",
    "After: valid position and hours > 0",
    "Final: hours capped; ghost_risk_hours computed"
  ),
n_pings = c(
  n_start,
  nrow(ghost_scored),
  nrow(ghost_fishing_speed),
  nrow(ghost_valid),
  nrow(ghost_pressure)
),
  pct_of_start = round(100 * c(
    n_start,
    nrow(ghost_scored),
    nrow(ghost_fishing_speed),
    nrow(ghost_valid),
    nrow(ghost_pressure)
  ) / n_start, 1)
)

Build yearly ghost gear GeoTIFFs (Pressure 3 only).

Sum of ghost_risk_hours (Gilman H_gear_ghost × capped hours) per 1 km cell.

Same filters as above: ghost score present, speed ≤ 6 kn, hours capped at 3 h.

Capped rasters use the 2024 99th-percentile value.

gilman_lookup <- gilman_by_permit %>%
  select(gear_type, target_species, H_gear_ghost)

filter_ghost_gear <- function(vms_year) {
  vms_year %>%
    left_join(gilman_lookup, by = c("gear_type", "target_species")) %>%
    mutate(ghost_gear_risk = H_gear_ghost) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ghost_gear_risk)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(implied_speed_knots), implied_speed_knots <= 6) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(hours), hours > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      hours_capped = pmin(hours, HOURS_CAP),
      ghost_risk_hours = ghost_gear_risk * hours_capped
    )
}

message("Computing 99th-percentile cap from ", CAP_YEAR, " (ghost gear)")
pings_cap <- load_vms_year(CAP_YEAR) %>% filter_ghost_gear()
r_cap <- rasterize_to_marine(pings_cap, "ghost_risk_hours", "ghost_risk_hours")
q99_ghost <- as.numeric(quantile(values(r_cap), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Ghost gear 99th-percentile cap: ", signif(q99_ghost, 4))

years <- YEAR_MIN:YEAR_MAX
walk(years, function(year) {
  message("\n=== Ghost gear year ", year, " ===")
  pings <- load_vms_year(year) %>% filter_ghost_gear()
  r <- rasterize_to_marine(pings, "ghost_risk_hours", "ghost_risk_hours")
  uncapped <- file.path(PRESSURE_ROOT, "ghost_gear", sprintf("ghost_gear_risk_%s_1km.tif", year))
  capped <- file.path(PRESSURE_ROOT, "ghost_gear", sprintf("ghost_gear_risk_%s_1km_capped.tif", year))
  write_pressure_pair(r, uncapped, capped, q99_ghost)
  message("Wrote ", basename(uncapped), " and ", basename(capped))
})

message("\nDone. Wrote ", length(years), " years of ghost gear rasters (uncapped + capped).")
